verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents its own import and export of realms as JSON files, including automated realm import via the operator. Realms contain users, which implies a bulk user path, and one community user reports moving from Auth0 was fairly easy. However, the evidence never says user records or password hashes are carried in these imports or exports. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that realm import/export includes users, import of existing password hashes (and from which hash formats), user-level export, and hands-on corroboration of a hash-preserving migration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-import existing users — including password hashes — and export them again, so I am never locked in

citations.quote: Import and export realms as JSON files.
Automate a realm import using the operator.
Each realm allows an administrator to create isolated groups of applications and users.
Moving from Auth0 was fairly easy.
